notes.title: THE DEADLY PATH – FAQ & COMMUNITY INFO
notes.content:
Hey Penitents,

[b]The Deadly Path[/b] has officially launched, and we are beyond grateful for your support! Whether you’ve been offering tributes, barely scraping through raids, or discovering new ways to (inevitably) perish, thank you for joining us on this cursed journey.

[h1]Leave us a Review – It Helps a Lot![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212693/8166da3a13aef543d0b6bf966f6f1cf9d86faac1.png[/img]

If you’re enjoying [b]The Deadly Path[/b], please consider leaving a [b]review on Steam[/b]. Your feedback means the world to us, and as a small indie team, it plays a huge role in supporting the game’s development and helping other players discover it.

Every review helps us grow, refine, and continue expanding [b]The Deadly Path[/b] - so let us know your thoughts!

[h2]👉 Leave a review here[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455350/The_Deadly_Path/

[h1]⚔️ THE DEADLY PATH – FAQ ⚔️
[/h1]
We’ve gathered some of the most frequently asked questions about [b]The Deadly Path[/b] to help you make the most of your time in the underworld. If you’ve got more questions, feel free to post them in the Steam discussions or [url=https://discord.gg/aeqeHm9uEJ]join our Discord community[/url]!

[h3]🕒 Is The Deadly Path launching in Early Access?[/h3]
👉 No - this is our full release! That said, we’ll still be continuing development post-launch with updates and fixes.

[h3]🎯 Will there be achievements?[/h3]
👉 Yes! There will be 18 achievements available at launch.

[h3]🕹️ Does The Deadly Path support Steam Deck?[/h3]
👉 We’re not Steam Deck Verified yet, but the game plays well on Deck thanks to our 16:10 resolution compatibility.

[h3]👥 Is there multiplayer or co-op?[/h3]
👉 No - The Deadly Path is a single-player experience, meticulously designed to let you face divine judgment all on your own.

[h3]📦 Will my progress carry over through updates?[/h3]
👉 Yes - we’ll avoid wiping progression where possible. If we do need to reset anything due to major changes, we’ll give you a heads-up.

[h3]🐛 How do I give feedback or report bugs?[/h3]
👉 We love hearing from you! Head over to our Discord and use the following channels:
• #feedback_and_suggestions – for ideas, balance, and general thoughts
• #bug-reports – for anything broken, cursed, or just plain weird
Also be sure to report any bugs to our online form you can find [url=https://fireshinegames.co.uk/customer_support/the-deadly-path/]HERE[/url]

[h3]💻 What platforms is The Deadly Path available on?[/h3]
👉 PC via Steam.

[h3]🎮 Will it come to consoles?[/h3]
👉 We'd love to explore bringing The Deadly Path to consoles in the future – for now, we're focused on making the PC version as good as it can be.

[h3]📹 Can I stream or make content about The Deadly Path?[/h3]
👉 Yes, yes, a thousand times yes. We love seeing your gameplay, chaos, and underworld-building tips. Tag us so we can share your creations!

[h3]📚 Is there lore I can read somewhere?[/h3]
👉 The gods are chatty and dramatic, so we’ll be sharing more lore via Steam blogs, in-game texts, and social posts. Keep your eyes peeled!

[h3]💀 What’s the actual goal of a run?[/h3]
👉 Survive the trials, manage your resources, build a thriving underworld settlement, and work towards completing the objectives set for you by your chosen deity.

[h3]🧱 Is there permanent progression?[/h3]
👉 Yes! Between runs, you can invest in upgrades using points earned by participating (successfully or not) in runs!

Thank you again for walking The Deadly Path with us. The gods are watching… and so are we. Stay tuned for future updates, and may your sacrifices be accepted!

– The Deadly Path Team

notes.title: ⚔️ The Deadly Path is OUT NOW! ⚔️
notes.content:
Hey, Penitents.

The wait is over – [b]The Deadly Path is officially OUT NOW![/b]

Step into a grim world of vengeful gods, desperate survival, and unrelenting raids - where every decision might be your last, and most roads lead to ruin (or worse, bureaucracy).

[h2]👉 Play now on Steam[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455350/The_Deadly_Path/

[h1]💀 Embrace the Path[/h1]
The Deadly Path is a survival strategy roguelike where your job is simple: appease terrifying gods and survive increasingly brutal trials in a cursed underworld that has absolutely no interest in being hospitable.

[list]
[*] Make offerings, manage your dwindling resources
[*] Survive devastating raids
[*] Try not to upset the gods, too much
[/list]
It’s bleak, it’s brutal, and it’s dangerously addictive.
[h1]🔥 Launch Price & Discount[/h1]
To celebrate launch, we’re offering a special discounted price for a limited time!

Usual Price: [b]£10.99 / €12.99 / $12.99[/b]
Launch Discount: [b]20% off until the 8th of April[/b]

Grab it while it’s fresh and the bloodstains are still drying.

[h1]⚔️ What’s Inside[/h1]
Expect grim glory, strategic chaos, and a cast of gods who definitely need therapy. Features include:

⚒️ Strategic underworld settlement-building

🧠 Tense resource management and decision-making

🎭 Procedurally generated runs and an array of tricky challenges

👹 A pantheon of furious, bizarre deities to appease (or provoke)

💀 Replayability through upgrades, unlocks, and multiple playstyles


Whether you're thriving or just trying not to starve to death in front of a god's statue, there's always something to challenge you on The Deadly Path.

[h1]Tell Us Everything[/h1]
We want to hear your thoughts, feedback, and grim tales from your runs. Join the community, report anything strange, and share your heretical strategies.

[url=https://discord.gg/aeqeHm9uEJ][h2]📣 Join our Discord[/h2][/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/aeqeHm9uEJ]Join us on Discord[/url] to discuss strategies with your fellow Penitents!
[h3] 🗣 Leave a review on Steam – it really helps![/h3]

[h1]The Gods Are Watching[/h1]
Thanks so much for all your support leading up to launch. We’re thrilled to have you walk The Deadly Path with us.

Now get out there, build your legacy, and try not to fall into a pit of snakes.

- The Deadly Path team

notes.title: Meet the Gods – Part 2
notes.content:
Greetings, Penitents.
Just when you thought you’d met the worst of them, the underworld has seen fit to introduce even more of it’s charmingly dreadful divine patrons. Whether you’re forging a path of glory or simply trying not to perish horribly, these gods are here to make things… interesting.
Let’s meet the next round of delightfully dreadful deities you’ll be trying to impress, appease, or simply survive.

[h1]EOCIDE[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212693/f5809ddac2879c15dc991e7e0dcfdcbaa607bbb2.gif[/img]

Blood, sulk, and rage, bottled in a divine vessel with a flair for melodrama.
A headstrong god with ideas well above his station and the temper of a caffeinated wasp, Eocide is a living conduit for blood magic. His body is scrawled with primordial markings - a visual diary of poor life choices and unacknowledged genius. Worship him if you must, but don’t expect gratitude. He’s still bitter about not making the top spot in the pantheon’s popularity contest.

[h1]THE THING THAT GROWS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212693/a5a6c77db70c39184b3a49ba2490202ace6ca28d.gif[/img]

Half god, half compost heap, all fury.
Overlord of the Dread Pantheon, this fungal terror commands deference with the subtlety of a falling anvil. His shriveled, spore-ridden form radiates power and a general discontent with absolutely everything. Cross him, and you’ll be mulch before the day is out. Then again, even smiling at him funny seems to qualify as a slight, so good luck.

[h1]BRASS LEVIATHAN[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212693/face25edb2eaa53d520d91862d2b271a15f33416.gif[/img]

Think ancient wrath meets eldritch grumble.
This enigmatic titan slumbers somewhere far below, seething in the abyss and muttering about the good old days. Its hulking brass form is less “majestic artifact” and more “forgotten horror that should probably stay buried.” But should it rise, expect chaos, destruction, and the distinct feeling that someone’s definitely getting blamed for waking it up.

[h1]MOTHER OF TEARS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212693/da9171867ccdc6e92ae74e732c72ac1cc499717f.gif[/img]

Tragedy personified - now with bonus wailing.
She is despair incarnate, a towering matriarch draped in sorrow and slightly questionable fashion choices. Equal parts corpse, crone, and catastrophic emotional baggage, the Mother of Tears isn’t so much worshipped as endured. Her dynasty needs restoring (apparently). Your involvement is mandatory. Bring tissues.

[h1]Join Us… If You Dare[/h1]

Each of these gods brings their own grotesque flavour to your run - new abilities, strategies, and, inevitably, fresh disasters. Whether you’re loyal to the Lord of Blight, whispering to rusted idols, or sobbing quietly under the weight of a fungal overlord’s disappointment, there’s something for everyone.

Don’t forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/aeqeHm9uEJ]Discord[/url], where you can chat with other Penitents, share your best (and worst) strategies, or scream into the void about your latest run.

The Deadly Path launches March 25th – wishlist now, before one of the gods takes offence.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455350/The_Deadly_Path/

notes.title: The Deadly Path Joins Next Fest!
notes.content:
Greetings, Penitents!

We have exciting news - the gods have spoken, and [b]The Deadly Path[/b] will be part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], running from [b]February 24th to March 3rd[/b]! This is an incredible opportunity for new players to descend into the underworld and for returning Penitents to experience the latest updates.

[h1]A Brand New Demo Awaits[/h1]
To celebrate our participation in [b]Next Fest[/b] we’re releasing a brand [b]new, updated demo[/b]! This isn’t just a simple patch - this version comes with new features, enhancements, and more to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212693/1124ac0505e52a2ca0915e59dbe39b16c9acafb5.gif[/img]

[h1]What’s New in This Demo?[/h1]
This updated demo is packed with fresh content and improvements [b]based on your feedback[/b]. Some of the highlights include:

[h2]A New Playable God: The One Who Rusts[/h2]
Unleash the power of decay and corrosion as you take on the role of [b]The One Who Rusts[/b]. With unique mechanics and abilities, this god offers a completely different playstyle, challenging you to rethink your strategies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212693/9586d8297a46478f84dc32cc7b57b77c8c7e61c7.png[/img]

[h2]Charms[/h2]
[b]Charms[/b], previously known as Power-Ups, will fundamentally change how you approach each run in The Deadly Path. [b]Charms [/b]offer new layers of strategy and adaptability as they introduce more impactful modifiers to each run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212693/e66e8aba7b36a0d05623d089c5c53c76f8bd1652.gif[/img]

Whether you’re a returning Penitent eager to dive into the new content or a newcomer curious about the world of [b]The Deadly Path[/b], this demo is the perfect opportunity to test your strategic prowess.

[h1]Mark Your Calendars![/h1]
Make sure to [b]wishlist the game[/b] and follow us on Steam to get notified when the new demo goes live. We’re excited to see how you tackle the challenges that await and can’t wait to hear your feedback!

The gods are watching… Will you rise to their challenge?

notes.title: Thank You for Your Feedback + A New Change is Coming
notes.content:
Greetings, Penitents!

First, we want to extend a massive thank you to everyone who has played [i]The Deadly Path[/i] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2463180/The_Deadly_Path_Demo/]demo[/url] and shared their feedback. Your thoughts, suggestions, and experiences have been invaluable in helping us refine the game.

We’re always looking to make [i]The Deadly Path[/i] the best it can be, so if you haven’t given feedback yet, we’d love to hear from you! Whether it’s a comment about balance, mechanics, UI, or general thoughts on your experience, every piece of feedback helps shape the future of the game.

[h2][url=https://fireshinegames.jotform.com/250132880089356]Submit your feedback here![/url][/h2]

[h2]Power-Ups Are Changing… Introducing Charms[/h2]
One of the biggest upcoming changes is the evolution of the Power-Up System into something new - [b]Charms.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212693/ab5e81370fc21045073dcac804ad412cdc2c6da2.gif[/img]

[b]Charms[/b] will fundamentally change how you approach each run, offering new layers of strategy and adaptability. While power-ups provided ways to enhance your runs, [b]charms[/b] will introduce more impactful modifiers to your [i]Deadly Path[/i] runs!

This is just one of the many changes coming based on your feedback, and we can’t wait to share more updates with you soon. Stay tuned, and as always - your fate is in your hands, Penitents.

notes.title: The Deadly Path Demo is Live!
notes.content:
Greetings, Penitents!
The wait is over - the gods have decreed that The Deadly Path demo is now live! This is your chance to descend into the underworld, prove your worth, and experience the dark depths of this roguelike strategy videogame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212693/8e5c0237f0043ad8b3cdefe08f2729e315022320.gif[/img]

[h1]What’s in the Demo?[/h1]
We’ve packed this demo with plenty of content to sink your teeth into. Here’s what awaits:

[h3]Learn the Ropes[/h3]
Start your journey with a comprehensive tutorial that will teach you the fundamentals of managing your underworld empire, appeasing the Dread Pantheon, and surviving the trials ahead.

[h3]Play as Roiann, The Blightcaster[/h3]
Step into the role of Roiann and experience their unique mechanics and challenges. Each god in The Deadly Path offers a distinct playstyle, and this is your first taste of what’s to come.

[h3]Unleash the Power-Up System[/h3]
Discover the brand-new power-up system and use it to bend the underworld to your will. Experiment with these powerful boosts to forge new strategies and optimize your runs.

[h3]Unlimited Runs[/h3]
There’s no limit to how many times you can play the demo. Refine your approach, master the mechanics, and see how far you can push your skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212693/37cc9f255add4c08054cc905829ea15469d5ebbc.gif[/img]

[h1]Ready for a Challenge?[/h1]
For those who conquer the demo, we’ve got some self-imposed challenges for you to try:
[b]Finish Faster[/b]: See if you can complete the game in fewer cycles than before.
[b]Use Fewer Power-Ups[/b]: Can you triumph with less divine intervention? Put your skills to the test.
Share your victories, strategies, and tips with the community—we’re eager to see how you rise to the challenge.

[h1]What’s Next?[/h1]
The gods are not done testing you. As part of Next Fest, we’ll be releasing another demo that includes another playable god alongside Roiann. This will be your chance to experience even more unique mechanics, challenges, and divine powers. Stay tuned for more details on who will join the Dread Pantheon next!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212693/0476e6f97bd98ba0b5a315dd78f767d97eaf2f85.gif[/img]

[h1]Join the Discord - Win a £10 Steam Giftcard[/h1]
Don’t walk The Deadly Path alone! [url=https://discord.gg/aeqeHm9uEJ]Join our Discord[/url] server to chat with other players, share your progress, and get the latest updates on the game. Plus, take part in our demo launch challenge: whoever completes Roiann's run in the fewest cycles will win a £10 Steam gift card! Compete, strategize, and claim the glory that awaits.
[url=https://discord.gg/aeqeHm9uEJ]Join Our Discord Here[/url]

notes.title: Prepare to Enter The Maw
notes.content:
Greetings, Custodians! 🩸

The gods have spoken, and the time has come for you to prove your worth. 
We are thrilled to announce that on [b]October 17th[/b], [i]The Deadly Path[/i] will open its gates for another [url=https://discord.gg/aeqeHm9uEJ]Discord playtest[/url], and for the FIRST time, you’ll get to serve the most barbaric and cunning deity yet—[b]The Maw![/b]

The Maw's underworld is no place for the faint-hearted, and in this playtest, you'll need every ounce of strategy to survive. Brace yourself for a deep dive into new gameplay features as you navigate the brutal, unforgiving world soon to be ruled by [b]The Maw[/b].

[h2]Here’s what you can expect:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]New God: The Maw[/b] – Barbaric, brutal, and endlessly cunning. Master the dark arts of their domain and appease them to ensure your survival.
[*] [b]Expanded Gameplay:[/b] Explore [b]The Maw's[/b] unique mechanics and challenges, flex your strategic muscles, and adapt to their devious ways to emerge victorious.
[*] [b]Exclusive Opportunity:[/b] We're asking participants to capture and share their playthroughs complete with commentary if possible! There are no dire consequences if you don’t, but the developers would be extremely grateful to see your gameplay footage.
[/list]

Sound like something you can handle? Well then, join us on [b]October 17th[/b], and test your mettle in the bowels of hell itself!

Want to get involved? Make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/aeqeHm9uEJ]Discord[/url] and read the [b]latest announcements[/b] on how to sign up for the playtest and receive further instructions. We’re eager to see how you fare against [b]The Maw’s[/b] savage challenges. 💀

We’ll see you just outside the gates of hell, Custodians… get ready!
